verdict.rationale: First-party docs say `semantic_text` fields automatically generate embeddings at index time using a configured model, with no need to define model settings or build inference ingest pipelines. Models can be deployed directly in Elasticsearch, used as external or hosted embedders, or configured through the inference API. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that query text is auto-vectorized at search time (only implied by "ingesting, embedding, and querying"), named Elastic-managed default embedding models, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
